text: {"assertions":["A blank render bug in ui/components/DataTable.tsx was identified and fixed on 2026-01-10.","The blank render issue only affected users with negative UTC offset timezones.","The root cause was schema drift between the database migration and the TypeScript model.","The fix involved regenerating the model from the migration and pinning the checksum in PR #3805 on branch fix/blank-render-1.","The bug manifested as an empty tbody element with no corresponding console errors.","The blank render issue could be reproduced by opening the data table with a saved column layout.","After the fix, p99 latency improved from 4.1 seconds to 147 milliseconds."]}
